title: How Green Account (checking) prevents overdrafts
summary: Explains how the How Green Account (checking) uses real-time authorization checks against your available balance before each transaction. A buffer of up to 5 may be considered; if the transaction would exceed your balance by more than 5, it’s declined (no negative balance). No automatic overdraft transfers are used, so the overdraft protection transfer fee is $0.00.
